title: Legislative Department Reviews Office Cleanliness and Pendency under Special Campaign 6 to Promote Swachhata
body_text: Legislative Department reviews its offices under ‘Special Campaign 6’ to institutionalise Swachhata and minimise pendency in government offices. The Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, conducted a review of its various sections, office rooms and sanitation facilities on the 4th floor of Kartavya Bhawan 2, New Delhi, on 23rd October, 2026, under Special Campaign 6, aimed at institutionalising Swachhata and minimising pendency in government offices. The review was led by Shri G. Panmei, Joint Secretary & Legislative Counsel (JS&LC) and Nodal Officer, along with Smt. Rachna, Under Secretary, and staff of the Admn.-II Section. During the review, Shri Panmei inspected the cleanliness and upkeep of office premises and common facilities. He interacted with the officers and staff members and emphasised the importance of maintaining cleanliness, hygiene and proper organisation of official spaces. He also directed all Section Officers to ensure that their respective sections and rooms remain clean, well-organised and free from unnecessary and obsolete materials. The review underscored the importance of collective responsibility, regular monitoring and the active participation of all officers and staff in maintaining a clean, hygienic and conducive working environment. The initiative reaffirmed the Legislative Department’s commitment to the objectives of Special Campaign 6 and to fostering a culture of cleanliness, efficiency and workplace discipline. **** Samrat/Sagar/Pranab
